InPaint 工作流程提供了大量的图像编辑选项。借助 Fooocus Inpaint、专门的 Inpaint 模型以及带差异扩散的自动遮罩选项等功能，您可以根据自己的喜好优化图像。深入 InPainting 的世界，发现这个强大工作流程的多功能性！

o.en:
The InPaint Workflow provides a wealth of options for image editing. With features like Fooocus Inpaint, specialized Inpaint models, and automatic masking options with Differential Diffusion, you can optimize your images according to your preferences. Dive into the world of InPainting and discover the versatility of this powerful workflow!
